demonstrated_counterexample.diagnostic_scope: Actual isolated execution of the existing selector with verified publisher metadata and synthetic approval flags. This is a mechanical counterexample, not an editorial approval or full-edition validation run.

root_cause: selectPodcasts compares publication timestamps against Date.parse(edition date), which is UTC midnight, rather than the recorded research cutoff. The real same-day episode is therefore rejected as future. Static inspection of validateEdition confirms that both video and podcast age calculations also use edition-date midnight; that independent code path must be repaired and regression-tested, not bypassed by changing source dates.
other_unresolved_conditions: Two videos with verified identity, date, runtime, content and audience fit have not been selected.
Captured YouTube LOGIN_REQUIRED bot-challenge responses do not establish a real video identity mismatch and cannot supply verified metadata.
Publisher episode pages resolve podcast metadata without raising feed byte limits, but metadata alone does not finish editorial or novelty review.
